T0576.title: Session Token
T0576.definition: A credential representing an authenticated session, often stored in a cookie or bearer token.
T0576.description: Session tokens represent authenticated state, so theft can let attackers bypass passwords and MFA. Common sources include XSS, malicious extensions, log leakage, compromised devices, and insecure cookie settings. Controls focus on HttpOnly, SameSite, Secure, short lifetimes, device binding, and abnormal-session revocation.
T0576.usageExample: Assess Session Token related exposure and define the corresponding controls.
